_source: three-ckpt's evaluator, jobs 239962 and 240045. Scored in the MODEL's voxel space: the albedo baseline's masks are authored in texture space and were lifted to voxels so both columns come from one evaluator. The 0.180 pbr_heuristic figure from the diagnostics is a different construction and is deliberately not reused here.
_lift_ratio: lifted voxel coverage divided by the baseline's own texture-space achieved coverage. 1.0 means the lift preserved the mask's extent. The lift is NOT uniformly biased: it inflates some shapes and deflates others, so no single correction factor applies and no aggregate carries it. Ratios run 0.30 to 1.75 and only three of seven sit inside [0.8, 1.25].
_trust: ok inside 0.8 to 1.25. Outside it the shape's IoU is partly an artefact of the lift: an inflated row overstates the baseline, a deflated row understates it.

aggregates._note: Reported as a range rather than a point, and the range is the weaker claim on purpose. The headphone stand nearly doubles the mean by construction and is also where the lift inflates most, so excluding it is the more trustworthy figure on two independent grounds. Only three of seven rows sit inside the lift's trust band. The ranking survives every observed lift correction: deflating the baseline by the largest distortion measured anywhere still leaves it ahead of the model.
